name: hyperdns
//: src/'s own library code has zero runtime dependencies - graph, store, etc. are always dependency-injected by the caller, and networking is fully delegated to hypergraph's own graph.connectToSwarm() rather than HyperDNS requiring hyperswarm directly. corestore/hypergraph/hyperswarm above are real dependencies because the shell (bin/cli.js, shell/) is a genuine shipped feature that constructs them directly at runtime - the library/shell split is what stays dependency-free, not the whole package. hypercore-crypto is a devDependency purely for the test suite. hypergraph is not on npm yet - for local development against an unpublished/in-progress checkout, run `npm link` from that checkout, then `npm link hypergraph` here to override this entry.
